createdBy: Created by Jason Schommer with JC Lippold
description: Dive headfirst into the wild chaos of growing up, growing older, and finding your place in the herd. Uproarious, poignant, nostalgic, and bursting with heart. The Schommer family puts the fun in dysFUNctional!

showTitle: 1 Hour Left to Live: A One Puppet Show by That Felt Good
createdBy: Directed by Phoebe Bottoms and Matt Olson
description: A puppet on his deathbed recounts his life through monologue, improvised flashbacks, audience participation, and stand-up comedy guest sets. Every night he lives a new life with new characters and old regrets.

A person sits on a bench at the edge of an abyss. A second person approaches their “heroic dive” at the edge. The two contemplate what pushes and pulls them from the edge in this award-winning dark comedy.

createdBy: Created by The Winding Sheet Outfit
description: The feckin' story and singy-song of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn. There be the famous supper club for some bored c*nts and dilettantes, and this be that time W. B. Yeats kicked Aleister Crowley's arse.

createdBy: Created by Thomas Nelson & Ray Huntley
description: A ridiculous parody retelling of A Midsummer Night’s Dream with classic Batman heroes and villains, told entirely in (almost) Shakespearean verse.

Following a devastating global pandemic, Jeff is left to fend for himself. Twelve years later, he’s built a farm, a solar array, and – to pass the time - a hobby of playing guitar for the audience in his head.
A Magician is the life memoir storytelling magic show of Las Vegas entertainer Jordan Rooks. This storytelling magical wonder is a combination of storytelling, clowning, and magic.
Tiffany is cursed to become versions of herself projected upon her and must learn who she is before time runs out.

createdBy: Written by Narate Keys & Directed by Abraham Vue
description: An Earth Goddess (Preah Mae Thorani) is a musical that explores Khmer culture during the Angkorian era, where King Jayavarman VII (1181–1218) reigned  with queen Jayarajadevi, Indradevi as his consort.

Based on the 1922 Pulitzer Prize winning play “Anna Christie” by Eugene O’Neill, it's been 15 years since Kris has seen her daughter Anna, and suddenly she’s here, at a bar in a small town you've never heard of

Stand-up comedy about salvaging sanity in our age of crazy. Presented by four-time Minnesota Fringe encore winning producer and Acme Comedy Co.'s Funniest Person in the Twin Cities title holder Ben San Del.
When a bumbling community theater group rehearses for their production of Hamlet, one actor tries to help them get their act together. This ensemble comedy is a love letter to community theater.

createdBy: Created by phillip andrew bennett low
description: Adapting for the first time 18th-century combat medic, historian, and POW David Ramsay, this fully AI-illustrated show features a different collection of readings each night.

showTitle: A Woman's Place is in the House
description: An interactive activist comedy following Minnesota's first four female legislators as they journey to today, joining the ongoing fight for equal rights - with various special guest speakers at each performance.

createdBy: Created by The Other Jeannie Retelle & Amie Durenberger
description: Set backstage at a drag show minutes before curtain, Bangs! unfolds during a shooting at a gay bar. This horror-comedy explores chosen family, queer resiliency, and finding absurd light in the darkest of times.

Four generations of smugglers from the river bottoms of Pike County, IL deal with their legacy of violence and crime, and the terrifying entity they accidentally smuggled over the veil from the other side.

createdBy: Written by Mariabella Sorini & Alex Church
description:
2012. A struggling farm in a northwestern ND town transformed by the oil boom is given a warning: A savior is coming. 
Portion of proceeds donated.

createdBy: Created by Peyton Brown & Jared Jeffries
description: A comedy self-improvement seminar. NOT a pyramid scheme. And DEFINITELY NOT a cult recruitment scheme! Award-winning  2-man show that garnered 5-star reviews at Edinburgh Fringe.
Norwegian for cabin fever, BRAKKESYKE is a new dark comedy about the banal degradation of boredom. Two soldiers wait at the edge of the world. The war is far away until it comes very, very close.

createdBy: Created by Ryan Klima and Kate Button
description: True stories. Masterful improvisation. Kate Button spills the stories, while the Twin Cities top improvisors weave them into comedy gold! Brace yourself for an evening of raw, unfiltered hilarity!

createdBy: Created by Sam Landman & Nissa Nordland
description: Meet Clyde & Faye, two character actors navigating an industry of auditions, rejections, bit parts and false starts. Sometimes funny, sometimes melancholy, it's improv so grounded, it seems scripted.

createdBy: Written by Duck Washington & Tim Wick
description: Everyone comes to Rick's. Even in the middle of a hostile occupation. Even in a world where lovers who have been torn apart by circumstance can bond over some well chosen Prince music.

createdBy: Created by Cali Garzon, Julia Maskin & Eli Maskin
description: A snip. A shriek. A bounce on cold linoleum. A songbird is born. Castrati: A Tale of Two weaves song with castration. Shed your bodily prison during this groundbreaking musical. The first and last of its kind.

createdBy: Created by Alexis Bacon & Alison Dobbins
description: “Chum!” is a musical parody of “Jaws” that invites audience members to bring a chum to be chum by telling the familiar tale of New England beach mastication in musical and interactive format.

A queer heroic comedy, in a new "old" adaptation of Edmond Rostand's "Cyrano de Bergerac." We've added sapphic flavor while retaining the period language and emphasizing the poetry of the original play.

Two zombified post-war corporate professionals attempt to run a workshop with the audience on how to face your fears. Outside, the darkness is creeping in threatening to end the show and maybe their friendship.
A good friend never forgets. Too bad, Dolly did. But no worries, it's her day off! No agenda, no script, no work...and all the time in the world for a little sweet, sweet revenge.

Why would a grown man practice somersaults in a pool? Patrick is neither athletic nor spontaneous. But it was a goal. For real. Laugh, maybe wipe away a tear, with Patrick as he recounts what led to the pool.

A musical and storytelling cabaret focused on radiance. Come watch what happens when artists are given the freedom to express themselves without limits. Three guest artists will be revealed throughout the run!

createdBy: Created by Laura Zabel and Levi Weinhagen
description: Empty Nest dives into life’s big transitions — aging, shifting identities, long-term partnership — and finds the humor in the awkward, poignant, and downright ridiculous moments along the way.

createdBy: Created by an alleged Theatre Company
description: Dr. Duke Didier is putting on a production of Death of a Salesman, in order to prove to his nephew that the play is still relevant in 2026. Too bad his nephew, Braedyn, couldn't give a shit.

A girl and her unicorn sidekick journey through a fantastical world to find her lost story. A powerful show about healing and moving forward. Puppets, humor, heart. Part of the Social Butterfly Project. 120 min

Three siblings gather in the wake of their mother's death—now orphans—to prepare her hoard for an estate sale. 
Trashy revelations, bizarre tapes left by their journalist father, and an unhinged auction follow.

createdBy: Created by Bella Maldonado & Lucía Salazar-Davidson
description:
June 28, 1966. A Beach Boys Circus... in the earthquake capital of the world. What could go wrong with this American Dream? 

Come for the music, stay for the drag, puppets, and camp-ified antics!
Guy For Now is a comedy for all ages! Join us on a journey of self-discovery as our everyman encounters a cast of *unique* characters who teach him about life, love, and the art of letting go.

createdBy: Created by Cleo Torres, Howdy Partner Dance, and cast

showTitle: HELL ON WHEELS: The Winter Strike of 1934
description: The true story of the families and truckers in Minneapolis who organized in order to survive the Great Depression. This first strike of 1934 led to the transformation of the North Star State.

description: This dramedy, with resurrection myth roots, explores the hells we create by trying to conform to gendered expectations in romantic relationships. It features Dramaturgy-on-Demand, a unique immersive experience.

description: Time to leave, but your hosts have other plans. Sinister agenda? Hostage situation? Or just another visit with your folks? Minnesota Goodbye meets The Twilight Zone. Grab a snickerdoodle, it might be your last!

showTitle: Improvised Love Is Blind--Minnesota Fringe Edition

description: The improvised version of the hit Netflix dating show, Love Is Blind. All of the fun. None of the toxicity.

A fast-moving show about the mysteries of language.  Why are words the way the are? How do languages change? Why is grammar hard? And what IS the plural of  "octopus," anyway? Every show will be different!

Mario and Luigi jump off the screen and onto the stage in this exciting musical adventure based on the cult classic 1993 movie! Featuring four original songs and all your favorite Mushroom Kingdom characters.

showTitle: I Will Become The Silver Surfer. I Will Protect You.
description: Galactus has chosen Earth as his next target. But don't worry. I will stop him. I will save you all. I will become The Silver Surfer.

description: A funny and moving story of two Turkish immigrants rebuilding their lives in America, confronting cultural differences, unexpected challenges, and the meaning of home.

An improvised musical comedy sermon about purity culture, power, and evangelical America. Featuring original songs, audience participation, and a charismatic pastor who may not be as holy as she seems.

A serial killer terrorizes Berlin while police come up empty. As fear grips the city, the criminal underworld launches its own manhunt to catch the murderer in this adaptation of the Fritz Lang noir classic.
This is the reimagined look at Sophie Treadwell’s 1928 expressionistic play about a woman trapped in a mechanical society that dictates how women should act and live.
A chaotic board game comes to life! Pick your champion, cheer from the stands, and watch the madness unfold. Every show is different—and one lucky audience member wins a copy of the game!
A solo clown show loosely inspired by history's most intelligent serial killer — blending masks, movement, lo-fi origami, and absurd logic into a lunatic tribunal of comedy, tenderness, and chaos.

Rest In Peace, Maxxeapolis, whose untimely deaths have landed them in Hell right before their performance at Fringe. Join them for an hour of sketch comedy where Satan himself will decide their ultimate fates.

It's Fishing Opener on Lake Mille Lacs, but some of the locals have started disappearing. Could it be the work of the terrifying, mythical Muskie? Find out in this Minnesota-based parody of "Jaws."

createdBy: Created by Margaret Marinoff and Stella Stockton
description: NOISE explores the sounds that shape our lives—both heard and unheard. Through movement, the work examines the emotional, mental, and physical noise that surrounds us every day: expectations, distractions, memories, relationships, and the constant demand for attention. Contrasting moments of chaos with profound stillness, NOISE asks what happens when the volume rises—and when silence becomes its own kind of deafening presence.

When the host of the children’s show Pistachio’s Playhouse experiences a sudden tragedy, she has to try and keep the Playhouse from closing while maintaining her sanity in front of an impressionable audience.

showTitle: Quadrilogy: A Sabathani Benefit Game Show Extravaganza!

Too expensive to go on a road trip? Then join two improv comedians as they take a ROAD TRIP without ever leaving the theater! You don’t need to pitch in for gas, just pitch in suggestions for destinations!

A man unwittingly crosses a picket-line, befriends an opossum, and is forced to choose between his job and his friend. The aftermath of his actions are discussed nearly a century later by two podcasters.

description: One woman performs scenes from Shakespeare’s comedies and tragedies exploring his deep understanding of the closest, longest and most frustrating relationship of your life: your relationship with your siblings.

description: Is being a dwarf clown REALLY half the size, but double the fun? Or is Tyler West just Small Minded? Either way, this show features juggling, magic, Shakespeare, story-telling, and some Ha-Ha's! from the heart.

An improvised soap opera inspired by audience suggestions. Our cast will create a show filled with your favorite soap opera tropes: steamy affairs, family betrayals, love triangles, seduction, and so much more!

So Bright the Night is a hard-boiled historical drama about the Mexican Repatriation of the 1930's. A woman boards a train in hopes to rescue her husband from deportation or worse. History is repeating itself.

New parents navigate pregnancy & pediatricians & preschool & poop. Somewhere in the realm of classic musicals like "The Fantasticks" or "I Do! I Do!" 
Featuring 8 new songs & captioned violin baby-talk.
Fringe veteran Jen Scott presents a one-person storytelling show, a music-show, a bit of a clown show, all about being human and maybe being heard.

description: Starting with a "first date" between an audience volunteer & Erika Sasseville, the cast will strive to predict the pair's compatibility and manifest the future of their relationship through improv and whimsy.

Third Fringe, & Wells thinks he's figured out the game.  And he wants to share it with you!  Work disasters, spirit world snafus, post Pearl Jam snacks, bootleg CDs, stories that'll make you go, "Oh Geez!"

A collective storytelling show featuring local artists sharing humorous tales around mental health. Personal or fantastical, these stories aim to share experience and possibly find catharsis through comedy.

description: An joyful spectacle where every step defies gravity.  A circus of rhythm and movement - join us where tap dancing meets the sky.

createdBy: Created by Lauren Go & Jake Mattinson
description: Connie thinks Shakespeare belongs in the past. Her uncle Ford knows better. A whirlwind tour through comedy, tragedy, and romance reveals the Bard's words may be closer to home than she thinks.

castList.role: Actor (Wall / Lion / Moonshine / Cassius / Second Witch)

showTitle: The Choose Your Own Adventures of Turtle Boy
description: A one-person puppet show with call and response/audience participation. The bashful but rowdy Turtle Boy leads you through an action movie of your own making. John Wick meets TMNT. Karate Kid meets Mr. Rogers.

A vampire take on The Importance of Being Earnest, that swaps cucumber sandwiches for a 1750 vintage Bellini Rosso Tavola Torciglioni. There’s blood; everyone’s horny. An Immortal Comedy for Lifeless People.

Samuel and Louise really know how to live; no morals, no regrets, no limits, no future.

It's the night before their reckoning day and they've come to crack a bottle of wine, swap tales, and have a little fun.

What’s the difference between BPD and BD? Is the expert always right? From anxiety to PTSD, storyteller Jena Young shares her experience with an undiagnosed parent, being misdiagnosed, and the power of labels.

Improv inspired by local music.
Local musicians perform original songs live.
Between songs the Local Music Scene cast improvise scenes inspired by the lyrics.
LOCAL MUSIC; improvised SCENEs

description: In the light of the half moon, a pack of manic-depressive werewolves howl about the myths and misconceptions surrounding their affliction. A raw, irreverent, humorous, bipolar crash out with teeth.

description: A new absurdest comedy by the people that brought you Breakfast in Bed and Another Cold One. Two characters find themselves lost on a journey. Delving into questions that rule our everyday decisions.

Billy Sipple became a hero when he saved President Ford’s life.  Days later, Harvey Milk publicly outed him.  What should have been a major win for gay rights ruined Sipple’s life.  Inspired by true events.

description: After a deadly stage collapse at a flamboyant bake-off, the show’s image-obsessed host is the prime suspect. Detectives navigate wildly contradictory accounts as paranoia and performance spiral into mystery.

Minnesota Fringe Executive Director and theatre virgin Dawn Bentley makes her first (and only?) fringe show. A personal, political, and playful storytelling experience fantasizing about how IT finally happens.
Therapist Zero is a darkly funny solo show about a father trying to help his brilliant but struggling daughter, only to run headfirst into a maze of psychiatrists, broken systems, and his own past.
An intimate solo performance blending Indian Classical and Folk dance and storytelling to explore migration, memory, and belonging. Can home be a place... or is it something we carry within us?

description: A televised debate between two incarcerated serial killers, moderated by a true-crime TV reporter, leads to revelations about their pathologies.
A charming musical comedy solo show plucked right out of the vaudeville era following cabaret performer Plucky Rosenthal and her quest to find the one thing she’s never had: a band.

description: Wake the Improv is a new, exciting show where 3 Improv groups interpret the audience dreams and nightmares into hilarious scenes. The audience participates with lighted wands and Ellie the Dream Wizard.

description: Digger. Listener. Runner. A small band of rabbits embark on a perilous journey to find a new home in this adventurous folk musical adaption of the classic children’s novel.

Life can be scary.  From falling in love to facing imposter syndrome, this storyteller’s guide looks at how anxiety and fear can overwhelm us, but that we can find the courage and grace to continue on our way.
One man's journey to discover identity after trauma, as told by brain injury survivor and master storyteller Lethan Candlish. Sharing a common journey of recovery from multiple perspectives.

showTitle: Who We Are: Stories from the Surge
description: True stories from folks who experienced, confronted, and did their best to get themselves and their neighbors through Operation Metro Surge; documentary theater with more than 3 dozen characters. Love to MN!

Operation Metro Surge pitted armed ICE agents against the residents of Minnesota. Kyle B. Dekker recreates a live rapid response call on stage based on his own experiences as a constitutional observer.
